title: GIST: Generator-state-Informed Supervision for Tabular Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.12904v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) based on prior-data fitted networks typically use sampled hard query labels, leaving avoidable sampling variability in pretraining. A key observation is that intermediate generator states can reveal label uncertainty beyond a sampled outcome. We propose Generator-state-Informed Supervision for TFMs (GIST), which uses these states to average query losses over conditional label distributions. GIST jointly designs task generation and query supervision, using entropy-calibrated encodings to obtain tractable, input-consistent targets on supported label-dependent branches. We show that this averaging preserves the population objective and yields no larger gradient covariance at fixed parameters within each generating distribution. Under matched pretraining schedules, GIST improves mean rank across three architectures on both TabArena and TALENT without changing architecture or inference. Across these benchmarks

translated_title: GIST：面向表格基础模型的生成器状态感知监督
translated_abstract: 基于先验数据拟合网络的表格基础模型（TFMs）通常使用采样得到的硬查询标签，这在预训练中留下了可避免的采样变异性。一个关键观察是，中间生成器状态能够揭示超出单个采样结果的标签不确定性。我们提出了面向表格基础模型的生成器状态感知监督（GIST），利用这些状态在条件标签分布上对查询损失进行平均。GIST联合设计了任务生成与查询监督，使用熵校准编码在支持的标签相关分支上获得可处理的、与输入一致的目标。我们证明这种平均方式保持了总体目标，并且在每个生成分布内固定参数的条件下不会产生更大的梯度协方差。在匹配的预训练调度下，GIST在不改变架构或推理的情况下，提升了三种架构在TabArena和TALENT上的平均排名。在这些基准上……
tldr: 提出GIST方法，利用生成器中间状态在条件标签分布上对查询损失进行平均，从而消除表格基础模型预训练中的采样变异性，并在不改变架构和推理的情况下提升TabArena与TALENT基准上的性能。
en_tdlr: GIST leverages intermediate generator states to average query losses over conditional label distributions, eliminating sampling variability in tabular foundation model pretraining and improving benchmark performance without changing architecture or inference.
